title: RETAIN Mandate
description: The engagement instrument between a principal and an agent brain. A Layer 8 companion to the peer agreement, never a replacement for it (RETAIN 6.1).

principal.description: The brain in which work is performed. Terms are relative to the engagement, never absolute.

custodyClass.description: Never a no retention class. Derived from placement, not from the relationship.

rolesHeld.description: Roles in the principal that the agent identity holds. The mandate names them and neither creates nor widens them (RETAIN 6.1).

containsEnvelope.description: Absolute. Authority is conferred by a delegation grant inside the principal, under DEFER. A mandate containing an envelope is RT-15.

projection.description: Preferred over a read permission, because a projection's boundary can be inspected and a folder permission's cannot (RETAIN 8.3).

digestBound.description: Regeneration changes the digest and dismisses prior approval, so stale consent cannot carry forward.

readPermissionFallback.description: Present only where a projection is not yet implemented. Reported as RT-28.

copyPolicy.description: The principal's material is held as TRACE A3 Copy: inherits classification, carries floors, expires (RETAIN 7.2).

expiry.description: ISO 8601 duration or the token on-termination, which is the default.

enumerable.description: The agent MUST be able to list the principal's copies it holds. One of two things nondisclosure does not cover.

evidenceGrade.description: Attested where the principal cannot verify expiry. Recording this makes the residual exposure visible rather than assumed away (RETAIN 13.3).

disposition.description: TRACE A2. It MUST NOT quietly become a permanent asset of the agent.

unexpiringVolumeMeasured.description: A summary of everything is a copy of everything (RETAIN 7.4).

judgmentTest.description: Could this judgment be stated to a different principal without disclosing anything about this one (RETAIN 7.3).

composition.description: The agent's own POLARIS plus the principal's floor. Additive, never exclusive (RETAIN 4.3).

noOutsourcedRefusal.description: The principal MUST NOT admit what its own POLARIS would have refused to produce (RETAIN 7.5).

conflictDeclared.description: True where any party outranks this principal.

conflictDecision.description: Required when conflictDeclared. Disclosure without a recorded decision is RT-17.

engagementDisclosure.description: Existence is disclosed; content is not. The principal MUST NOT rely on absence of disclosure (RETAIN 6.3).

registrations.description: Both are required. An agent brain is a provider and a peer at the same time (RETAIN 8.1).

inferenceProviderId.description: CONFIDE registration for the continuous inbound flow.

peerAgreementId.description: SPEAK agreement for deliberate outbound assertions.

reconciled.description: Where the two imply different limits, the more restrictive governs (RETAIN 8.2).

singlePageReportRef.description: An agent brain that cannot be described on one page is one nobody is governing.

crossDomainControl.description: Cross domain learning is undetectable by construction. Controls are structural and applied before the engagement (RETAIN 11.3).

preventionClaimed.description: A claim of prevention or detection is RT-39.

consequenceClass.description: K3 minimum, since admission establishes a continuing boundary crossing. K4 where a named role holds a constitutional envelope.

utterancesPreAdmitted.description: Trust earned over an engagement is a reason to widen the projection, never to bypass admission (RETAIN 6.5).

coordinator.description: A coordinator is a party, never infrastructure, and holds the union of what it coordinates (RETAIN 9.2).

signature.description: Two signatures. The agent signs with its own key, which is what distinguishes a mandate from a directive.
